Get available end years under default selectors

Source: R/available_years.R
get_available_years.Rd

Reports years served by a type's fetcher with `source = "live"` or `source = "package"`, and all other selectors at their defaults. Coverage is computed offline from the declarations the fetchers enforce. Years requiring non-default selectors or private stores are excluded.

Usage

get_available_years(type = NULL)

Arguments

type

A single fetch family name, such as `"enrollment"`, or `NULL` for all declared types.

Value

With `type`, a sorted, unique integer vector of school year ends. With `NULL`, a data frame with columns `type`, `end_year`, and `fetcher`, ordered by type and year. Gaps in coverage remain visible.

Details

Enrollment, absence, graduation, finance, sped, sped_by_grade, sped_share, ell, graduation_count, graduation_6yr, assessment_access, state_aid and essa_chronic_absence coverage is declared. Absence excludes 2020, when chronic absenteeism was not published. Assessment requires explicit grade/course and subject selectors and remains undeclared. Other known fetch families raise an error containing "coverage not yet declared".

Examples

get_available_years("enrollment")
#>  [1] 1999 2000 2001 2002 2003 2004 2005 2006 2007 2008 2009 2010 2011 2012 2013
#> [16] 2014 2015 2016 2017 2018 2019 2020 2021 2022 2023 2024 2025 2026
get_available_years()
